items.title: Bangladesh to tour Nepal for three T20Is in March 2027
items.summary: It will be the first international bilateral series between the two countries

items.title: Tigresses begin Asian Games campaign against China
items.summary: Bangladesh women’s cricket team will begin their Asian Games 2026 campaign tomorrow against hosts China in the quarterfinals at Korogi Sports Park in Japan.

items.title: Bangladesh-Nepal series in March to honour Nepal flood victims
items.summary: Bangladesh will tour Nepal for a three-match T20I series in March next year, with the series to be dedicated to the memory of those who lost their lives in the devastating floods that recently hit Nepal.

items.title: Bangladesh committee names Asif Nazrul as sole decision-maker of pulling out of T20 World Cup
items.summary: The three-member committee concluded that the BCB at the time lacked "independent strategic leadership, crisis diplomacy capability and long-term planning"

items.title: Khaled ‘fills Hasan’s shoes’ with maiden county fifer
items.summary: Bangladesh fast bowler Khaled Ahmed claimed his maiden five-wicket haul in county cricket as he helped Kent recover after Lancashire’s strong start on Day 1 in Canterbury on Tuesday.

items.title: Hasan Mahmud withdrawn from Kent duty by BCB
items.summary: Fast bowler rested ahead of busy international winter with county vying for promotion

items.title: Mehidy four-for takes Amazon Warriors to eighth win; TKR finish last
items.summary: Trinbago Knight Riders, the defending champions, finished bottom of the table after sinking to their seventh defeat of the season
